remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3,000+ square-foot home on .65 acres offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and location. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, plus a fully finished basement adding 500+ additional square feet of living space, this home is thoughtfully designed to accommodate both everyday living and special gatherings.  Abundant natural light fills this home throughout! The main level features formal living and dining rooms for entertaining or everyday use, bright kitchen with oversized eat-in space opens to a spacious family room with vaulted ceilings, creating an airy, inviting setting for relaxation or gatherings.  The first floor also features a generously sized mudroom and laundry room, adding everyday convenience and organization to busy lifestyles. A flexible first-floor layout allows for a potential home office or guest suite to suit your needs.  Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, an oversized walk-in closet, and a private full bath. Two additional spacious bedrooms and a full bath complete the second level. The finished basement provides even more flexible living space-ideal for a recreation room, media room, home gym, or play area. Set in a highly desirable community known for its top-rated schools, this home is conveniently located just minutes from downtown, train, and popular shopping destinations.
